scripts.// no-prepare: Deliberately NO prepare hook. npm runs a file: dependency's prepare during a CONSUMER's `npm install`, but before core's own devDeps (typescript) are on PATH, so `tsc` fails with `command not found` (exit 127) on any fresh install (Vercel/CI/fresh clone). It only ever worked when core's node_modules already existed. Consumers build core explicitly instead — app via `build:core`, server via render.yaml buildCommand — so dist/ (gitignored; main/types point into it) exists before anything compiles against it.
